title: Item 23 documented regulatory and privacy reading record
description: One question about Australian medical device, clinical trial, privacy, recording, ethics or professional regulation, read against public primary sources and recorded with the exact wording relied on. A record is a documented reading by a non lawyer. It is never advice, a determination, an approval, a classification decision or a defence, and the schema cannot express that it is. Every record must name at least one accountable human role that has to settle it.

applies_to_purposes.description: Which rungs of the intended purpose ladder this question bites on. The ladder is defined once, in the registry.

primary_sources.description: The sources the reading rests on. At least one must have been read directly at the source, on a recorded date, with the exact wording relied on quoted. A reading built only on secondary description is not admissible here, because this repository has already been wrong three times by carrying forward figures nobody checked.

currency.description: The version, compilation or last updated date the source itself states. A source that states none says so here.

extract.description: The operative wording, quoted rather than paraphrased.

reading.description: What the sources appear to say about this question. Written as a reading, never as a conclusion of law.

confidence.description: How far the sources settle the question on their own words. None of these values means the question is closed, because closing it needs a person.

unresolved.description: What this reading could not settle. A record with material uncertainty or worse must carry at least one entry.

conflicts.description: Where two sources disagree. Recorded rather than resolved, because resolving a conflict means choosing which source to believe.

consequences.description: What follows for this project if the reading holds. Consequences are stated so the reading is useful, not so it becomes an instruction.

decided_by.description: The accountable human roles that must actually settle this. Every record has at least one, because no record here settles anything.
